reactor-atom-density-breeder-sim.title: Atom Density, Breeding Ratio & Doubling Time Simulator
reactor-atom-density-breeder-sim.desc: Calculates atomic number densities for actinide fuels and solves the breeding gain differential equation, computing fissile inventory accumulation and doubling time in fast breeder reactors.

reactor-neutron-attenuation-flux-sim.title: Neutron Beam Attenuation & Reaction Rate Simulator
reactor-neutron-attenuation-flux-sim.desc: Simulates exponential attenuation I(x) = I0 * exp(-Σt * x) of a monoenergetic neutron beam propagating through shielding materials, displaying macroscopic cross section, mean free path, and HVL.

reactor-fission-yield-spectrum-sim.title: Fission Mass Yield & Prompt Neutron Watt Spectrum
reactor-fission-yield-spectrum-sim.desc: Displays the empirical asymmetric double-hump fission product mass yield curve Y(A) for U-235 and Pu-239 alongside the Cranberg/Watt prompt fission neutron energy distribution χ(E).

reactor-fuel-burnup-energy-sim.title: Reactor Thermal Power & Fuel Burnup Dynamics
reactor-fuel-burnup-energy-sim.desc: Simulates fuel consumption, fission rate, daily U-235 burnup, and core burnup accumulation (MWd/MTU) over multi-month reactor operating campaigns.
